title: Choose LoopCut's visual world
question: The roll assigned Riso Meme Press. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Riso Meme Press
options.lineage: riso-printed meme zines, xerox flyers and die-cut sticker sheets
options.thesis: Every clip is pulled like a riso print: two spot inks, crop marks, and a neutral bed where the image is judged.
options.viewport: A neutral monitor bed fills the center ringed by pink crop marks; a numbered frame strip below; inspector sheets right with a yellow halftone size meter.
options.risk: Tips into toy the moment the inks leave their functional roles (pink = cut and selection, yellow = output).

raised.raise: Only registration furniture frames regions: crop and registration marks and 1px hairlines, no rounded containers.
States are printed marks: hairline at rest, ink-filled when pressed, struck through when disabled, bracketed on focus.
Sizes ride one fixed halftone ramp: the export estimate's dot density is the file size.
The frame strip packs whole numbered cells edge to edge, never a partial thumbnail.

options.label: Instant Replay Suite
options.lineage: esports broadcast replay controllers and program monitors
options.thesis: Clip the highlight like a replay operator: jog, cue in, cue out, roll.
options.viewport: A program monitor with safe-area guides and burned-in timecode; cue buttons and a jog strip beneath; clip bank to the side.
options.risk: The most familiar option here: close to the dark-NLE look most editors already ship.

options.label: Darkroom Exposure Record
options.lineage: darkroom printers' exposure record cards and zone-system wedges
options.thesis: The grade as an exposure card: an eleven-step zone ramp and stop deltas govern every tone.
options.viewport: The monitor under an enlarger glow; the grade panel is a zone wedge with stop deltas; trimmed ranges hatched on the strip.
options.case: Fuses best with color grading and exposure; gamers and meme makers do not live in darkrooms.
options.risk: Reads photographic-niche, and hatching can slow scanning of dense panels.

options.label: Departure Board
options.lineage: boarding passes and live airport gate boards
options.thesis: Exports as departures: every platform preset ranked live by whether this clip fits.
options.viewport: The monitor above a live board of Discord, X and Telegram rows with size-fit status; export settings as pass segments.
options.case: Strongest at honest size control; travel culture is not the audience's world.
options.risk: The board metaphor can crowd editing surfaces it does not serve.

options.label: Design Annual Plate Section
options.lineage: design annual plate pages on uncoated stock
options.thesis: A gallery sheet with registration crosshairs at every plate corner.
options.viewport: One continuous light sheet with hairline-divided rows.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a light gallery sheet fights the night-time grading surround and the audience.
options.risk: Cold and editorial for a clipping tool.

options.label: Ruled Reference Page
options.lineage: wide-margin scholarly editions with a centre rail
options.thesis: Two columns around one moving rail of keys.
options.viewport: A small text block inside a wide annotation margin.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a scholarly page has no place in clipping culture.

options.label: Convention Circle Catalog
options.thesis: Thousands of stamp-size cells in a numbered grid, circled in biro.
options.viewport: A packed numbered thumbnail grid keyed to a hall map.
options.case: Narrow miss: meme-adjacent but niche, and no clearer than the press.
options.kept: Whole numbered frame cells packed edge to edge.

options.label: Star Atlas Chart
options.thesis: Magnitude as ranked dot size on a coordinate sphere.
options.viewport: Overlapping chart plates with a named-object index.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the night sky says nothing about clipping.
options.kept: One fixed magnitude ramp for sizes.

canonCard.label: The pro NLE standard
canonCard.thesis: What Resolve and Premiere ship, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A centered program monitor, docked panels, blue selection.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every editor by design.
